meta.title: Pricing
meta.description: Every Vink plan includes everything: unlimited users, all Forms and Fields, review and webhooks. Choose how many items. From €49 a month, 20 free items to start.

og.title: Every plan includes everything. You only choose how many items.
og.alt: Vink pricing. Every plan includes everything. You only choose how many items.

header.title: Every plan includes everything. You only choose how many items.
header.subtitle: An item is a PDF page, an email or a photo. Prices in EUR, excl. VAT. + VAT where applicable.

plans.starter: For a team that handles a few papers a day.
plans.team: For a team that processes new mail every hour.
plans.business: For departments with a steady stream of paperwork.

free: Start with 20 free items. No credit card.

custom.name: Custom
custom.title: Need more than 3,000 items a month?
custom.body: From {price} a month, billed annually. A volume price, custom terms and a service level agreed with you.

users.title: Unlimited users
users.body: Invite the whole team. No seat count.

forms.title: All Forms and Fields
forms.body: As many Forms as you need, with your own Fields and Lists.

review.title: Review and Approval
review.body: Check what's unsure, approve, or let Auto-Send handle the sure ones.

integrations.title: Integrations (webhook)
integrations.body: Signed JSON to your system, with retries and a test-send.

users.a: No. Every plan has unlimited users. You pay for items, not seats.

page.a: One PDF page, one email or one photo is one item. So a 10-page PDF counts as 10 items. In an email, the text counts as 1 item, each attached PDF counts its pages and each photo counts 1. A short cover note for attachments and small signature images are free. Vink counts an item once, when it reads it. Retries after a failed read are free. Moving a Submission to another Form is free too.

runOut.q: What happens when our items run out?
runOut.a: A new upload that doesn't fit your remaining items is refused, with a clear message. Everything already uploaded keeps working. You can upgrade, or add a top-up of €10 per 100 items that lasts until the end of the current month.

rollover.a: No. Your items renew every month, also on annual billing, and unused items expire.

vat.q: Are prices with or without VAT?
vat.a: All prices are in EUR, excl. VAT. VAT is added where applicable.

cancel.a: Yes, you can cancel at any time. Your plan then runs until the end of the current month or year. After that, you pay nothing more. The 20 free items need no card and have no end date.

intake.q: How does your paperwork get in?
intake.a: Upload several PDFs and photos at once in the app, or email them to a Form's own address. Vink turns each email into one or more Submissions. PDFs of up to 10 MB and 20 pages. Other sources? <link>Tell us</link>.

jsonld.description: Vink reads PDFs, emails and photos, typed, scanned or handwritten, and turns them into clean JSON for your systems. People only check the values Vink isn't sure about.
jsonld.offer: {count} items a month, billed monthly, excl. VAT
